title: Dependency Cycles — digital services
count: 3 tangles across 6 modules · break plans attached

prov.label: SIMULATED · would derive from: SCC analysis of the service dependency graph (Istio call graph + static import scan)

rows: Cart calls Promotions to evaluate offers → Promotions calls back into the Cart API to verify threshold lines → re-prices the cart
⚠ p99 cart latency doubles during promo storms; the two services must release in lock-step
Pass full cart context in the evaluate request; make Promotions stateless toward Cart; delete the callback
Checkout posts points earn → Loyalty burn authorization calls back into Checkout totals to validate the tender mix
⚠ retry storms double-issue points; split-brain on partial failures during peak
Authorize burn before tender selection; publish earn as an async event consumed by Loyalty
Nightly export feeds the search index → search-derived popularity & synonyms are written back into PIM attributes → re-exported the next night
⚠ a bad popularity writeback forces a full reindex; the circular chain delays publish ≈90 min
Keep search-derived signals in a search-owned ranking store; remove the PIM writeback
